answer_risk_cost_target.characters_interpretation: deterministic context-volume proxy only; not measured tokens, latency, memory, or cost

baseline_decision.reason: No restricted frontier passes both the frozen margin and a frozen context budget.

frozen_before_output.cost_budget_1: total visible evidence characters <=75% of always-expand and <=3 deterministic retrieval actions
frozen_before_output.cost_budget_2: total visible evidence characters <=50% of always-expand and <=3 deterministic retrieval actions

legally_recoverable_evidence.method: Offline: exact target/operand recovery from canonical table or gold rel_paragraphs plus visible scale resolution; gold is never passed to build_frontier_actions.

reference_completeness.not_model_ready_action: UNKNOWN is the predeclared offline response for the one hidden percent-scale item; it remains excluded from the primary paired answer-risk denominator.
